regulation: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) with Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774 (RTS on ICT risk management)

check_kinds.prowler: Failing Prowler findings mapped to this article by compliance key or check-id prefix; `unverified` when no scan ran.
check_kinds.trivy: The dependency and image vulnerability scan judged against the RTS Art. 10 patch policy.
check_kinds.provenance: The agent-action ledger: chain integrity, stage completeness, anchor coverage (pf provenance verify).
check_kinds.file: A repository or entity file that must exist; `{group}` and `{project}` are bound from the entity.
check_kinds.declaration: A value in the entity's resolved aidf.yaml that must be set.
check_kinds.workflow: A GitHub Actions workflow that must exist and carry the named step.
check_kinds.air: The entity's committed AI-control baseline (air.yaml) and its gate.
check_kinds.live_github: Repository settings read through the GitHub API; only with --live and a token, otherwise `unverified`.

articles.title: Governance and organisation
articles.requirement: The management body defines, approves and oversees the ICT risk management framework and names accountability for it.

checks.description: An accountable owner is named for this entity's ICT risk framework.
The entity carries its own policy overlay, reviewed like code.

articles.title: ICT risk management framework
articles.requirement: A sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework, reviewed at least yearly and on major incidents.

checks.description: The entity commits to a control baseline in air.yaml and `pf air gate` blocks a regression of it.
Binding runtime constraints for autonomous agents are written down and read at every loop start.

articles.title: ICT systems, protocols and tools
articles.requirement: ICT systems, protocols and tools are appropriate, reliable, of sufficient capacity and technologically resilient.

checks.description: A CycloneDX software bill of materials exists for the platform's dependency tree.
Every vendored upstream is pinned and its adoption recorded (pf vendor verify).

articles.title: Identification
articles.requirement: Identify, classify and document all ICT-supported business functions, information assets and ICT assets, and their dependencies; review at least yearly.

checks.description: Cloud resources are discovered and configuration recording is on.
The entity's data assets, dependencies and lineage are in its knowledge graph, rebuilt and checked in CI.

articles.title: Protection and prevention
articles.requirement: Security policies, access control, MFA, encryption, network segmentation and secure configuration, continuously monitored.

checks.description: Least-privilege IAM, MFA, secret hygiene and encryption at rest.
Security groups, VPC boundaries and external ingress limits.
The path gate denies credential files and generated artefacts to every agent in every session.

articles.title: Detection
articles.requirement: Mechanisms to promptly detect anomalous activities, with multiple layers of control and defined alert thresholds.

checks.description: Audit logging, threat detection and alerting are on for the entity's cloud account.
Deterministic monitors (freshness, PII, drift, vendor) run on a cadence with a circuit breaker and a ledger.

articles.title: Response and recovery
articles.requirement: ICT business continuity policy, response and recovery plans, tested and reviewed.

checks.description: Backups, versioning and deletion protection on the entity's data stores.
Agent execution can be revoked platform-wide (pf provenance revoke) and revocation is honoured before any intent is written.

articles.title: Backup policies and procedures, restoration and recovery
articles.requirement: Backup policies specify scope and frequency; records are integrity-protected; restoration is tested.

checks.description: The agent-action ledger is a SHA-256 hash chain: every record links to the one before, every action has all three stages.
The chain head is anchored to an RFC 3161 timestamp authority and OpenTimestamps; records since the last anchor are flagged.

articles.title: Learning and evolving
articles.requirement: Gather information on vulnerabilities and threats, conduct post-incident reviews, and feed lessons back into the framework.

checks.description: Lessons are recorded as memory notes per module and indexed; the index is checked in CI.
Dependency vulnerabilities are scanned nightly and on every lockfile change.

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: Crisis communication plans and channels to staff, clients and counterparts.

checks.description: The family has a declared notification channel for loop findings and questions.

articles.title: ICT-related incident management process
articles.requirement: Detect, manage and notify ICT-related incidents; record all incidents and significant cyber threats.

checks.description: Loop observations are filed as issues, updated in place and closed on the next clean run.
Review findings become tracked issues with priority, effort and an owner.

articles.title: General requirements for digital operational resilience testing
articles.requirement: A risk-based testing programme, run by independent parties, with findings prioritised and remediated.

checks.description: The platform suite runs on every pull request that touches shared code.
The provenance chain, the static governance scan and the control baseline run in CI.

articles.title: Testing of ICT tools and systems
articles.requirement: Vulnerability assessments and scans, source code reviews, scenario-based tests and penetration testing where appropriate.

checks.description: The infrastructure and supply-chain audit runs nightly and on demand, and its evidence is archived.
No fixable Critical or High vulnerability is older than its patch window.

articles.title: General principles on managing ICT third-party risk
articles.requirement: A register of information on all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party providers, and due diligence on each.

checks.description: Every borrowed upstream is registered with what was taken, how tightly, and why.
Upstream drift against every pin is checked on a schedule.

articles.title: RTS 2024/1774 Art. 10 — Vulnerability and patch management
articles.requirement: Identify and evaluate vulnerabilities, track their remediation, and deploy patches within a defined and risk-based timeframe.

checks.description: Every fixable vulnerability is patched within the grace window its severity allows, or carries a dated, owned exception.

articles.title: RTS 2024/1774 Art. 16 — ICT systems acquisition, development and maintenance
articles.requirement: Secure development practices, source code review, testing before production, and segregation of environments.

checks.description: The default branch requires a pull request, passing checks and no force pushes.
Every commit passes the path gate, the evidence rule and the file cap before it lands.
Agent output contracts, SQL AST checks and PII redaction are tested in CI for every entity.
